name: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA A-B-C Companion
purpose: Use Image A as subject reference, Image B as background reference, and Video C as motion reference.

expected_inputs_in_workflow.Image 2: Image B / background or environment reference

recommended_defaults.resolution_note: Start small, e.g. 460x460 or 512x512 for testing.

prompt_template_lines: <Environment 1> is the background / location shown in <Image 2>.
Generate a target video where <Subject 1> appears inside <Environment 1> and follows the body motion, timing, and camera rhythm of <Video 1> as closely as possible.
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - preserve identity, face, hair, body shape, clothing silhouette if visible, and overall appearance from <Image 1>.
<Environment 1>: strongly_referenced - reproduce the background, location mood, spatial feel, and visual setting from <Image 2>.
<Video 1>: motion_reference - reproduce the motion pattern, body movement, timing, and camera feel from <Video 1> as closely as possible.

[Shot 1] The target video is realistic and coherent. <Subject 1> is placed naturally inside <Environment 1>. The subject performs movements closely matching <Video 1>, including pose transitions, timing, and overall motion rhythm. Keep the subject clearly recognizable as the person from <Image 1>. Keep the background faithful to <Image 2> while integrating the subject naturally into the scene.
